mechanism: Eslicarbazepine may induce CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially reducing ethambutol efficacy, and both agents carry risk of peripheral neuropathy and optic neuritis.
action: Monitor for reduced tuberculosis treatment efficacy and signs of peripheral neuropathy or visual changes; consider ethambutol dose adjustment or alternative antituberculous agent if seizure control requires high-dose eslicarbazepine.
